title: Midnight Black Sparkly Quartz Tiles
description:
Create a Sparkly look on Walls and Floors
Black quartz has a sparkly appearance created by reflective mirror pieces which cover the surface of this wall and floor option. A polished finish provides a sleek look and also makes the Midnight Black easy to clean in bathrooms and kitchens. Used primarily within modern designs, they work effectively when combined with a light coloured grout for a stylish contrast. They are regularly matched with white quartz, producing a timeless interior design. These premium tiles have a 97% quartz content and are manufactured through an innovative technological process.

Choose Quartz for modern Bathrooms and Kitchens
If you are looking to create a modern style within your home then black quartz is the perfect option. The combination of a standout appearance and high level of practicality makes it a great choice for contemporary layouts. Black is a colour which can be incorporated within a vast array of decors and can be complemented superbly by popular white and cream coverings. Versatile black quartz is ideal for either a bathroom or kitchen interior.

Premium Quartz Tiles
Engineered quartz from Tilesporcelain has a low moisture absorption rate making them suitable for shower areas. If you choose them for your home you’ll soon discover they are extremely low maintenance. Furthermore, the hard wearing quality ensures they can be installed in high traffic areas, thus explaining why they are regularly chosen for shops and hotels. This is a premium option but don’t just take our word for it, order a sample for a closer look. Quartz is resin based and it’s therefore entirely at your own risk should you use them with under floor heating systems or within environments which are exposed to high thermal conditions, including conservatories, sunrooms, near glass patio doors and outdoor areas. We recommend that latex adhesive is not used for tiling quartz.

title: Diamond White Sparkly Quartz Tiles
description:
Diamond White Sparkly Quartz Tiles
These engineered white quartz tiles, made with 97% quartz with 1mm bevel edge, provide a standout appearance and highly durable covering in bathrooms and kitchens. Containing more mirror fleck per m2 than any other tile on the market, these sparkly quartz wall and floor tiles are a great option for contemporary layouts. Light bounces off Diamond White Quartz flooring to produce a glittery appearance. You can also make walls glisten by choosing these white sparkle tiles which are available in a range of sizes.

Low Maintenance and Durable White Polished Mirror Quartz
White quartz certainly has the substance to match its bling. This tile is notable for having an incredibly low moisture absorption rate making it easy to clean and maintain. As a result of the manufacturing process which involves fusing crushed resin with quartz, this tile is among the hardest wearing and most durable options for high traffic areas. These tiles are therefore perfect for busy public spaces, including the expansive interiors of airports and shopping centres.

Sparkly Diamond White Quartz Walls and Floors
Provide your walls and floors with a real wow factor by choosing these Sparkly Diamond White Quartz Tiles. For a classic look you can match them with our Midnight Black Quartz Tiles in your bathroom or kitchen. The use of quartz in outdoor areas, with under floor heating systems and within high thermal environments is at your own risk. These areas include conservatories and in close proximity to patio doors. Latex adhesive is not recommended for applying quartz to walls and floors.

Are you looking for a stylish and durable flooring option for your home? Consider Jazz Black Marble Effect Porcelain Tiles, which offer the classic look of marble with the practicality of porcelain. Luxury Jazz Black Marble Effect Porcelain Tiles Kitchen & Bathroom Designs
When it comes to home decor, your flooring plays a major role in setting the tone for any space. Jazz Black Marble Effect Porcelain Tiles can help you achieve a luxury feel to your kitchen and bathroom designs that will last for years. Featuring an intricate yet minimalistic design, this tile can be used on walls and floors to add some sophistication to your home interiors. The durability of porcelain also means that these tiles are perfect for high-traffic areas like kitchens and bathrooms where they will withstand wear and tear over time.

The beauty and benefits of using porcelain tiles for your home décor
Porcelain tiles are not only beautiful, but they also come with a host of benefits that make them a great choice for your home décor. One of the biggest advantages of porcelain is its durability. These tiles are made from a denser clay than traditional ceramic tiles, making them less susceptible to chipping and cracking. They are also highly resistant to moisture, which makes them perfect for use in kitchens and bathrooms where spills and splashes are common. In addition, porcelain tiles are easy to clean and maintain, so you can enjoy their timeless aesthetic without worrying about extensive upkeep.

Let an Elegant Colour Palette Reflect Your Style with Marble Effect Tiles.

description:
Panda White Marble Effect Porcelain Tiles - Add Style & Class to Any Home
Panda White Marble Effect Porcelain Tiles offer homeowners a beautiful and timeless way to upgrade their interiors. While they’re designed to look like real marble, their durability and versatility is unmatched. Elegant yet affordable, these tiles can instantly create an eye-catching aesthetic that will leave guests impressed for years to come.

What are Panda White Marble Effect Porcelain Tiles?
Panda White Marble Effect Porcelain Tiles are stylish, affordable tile flooring produced with durable porcelain material. Individually they showcase a unique marble effect pattern that makes them stand out from other tiles on the market. Compared to real marble, these porcelain tiles offer superior endurance and strength while still creating an exquisite aesthetic that resembles real marble.

Ways to Incorporate Fashionable Marble Designs in Home Decor
Whether you’re looking to remodel your kitchen, bathroom or living room space, incorporating Panda White Marble Effect Porcelain Tiles is a great way to add class and sophistication into any area. These tiles can be installed on floors, walls and more, giving homeowners the flexibility to design their dream space with ease.

Tips for Maintenance and Cleaning of Porcelain Tiles
To keep your Panda White Marble Effect Porcelain Tiles looking their best, it's important to properly maintain and clean them. Ensure that spills are wiped up immediately as this will reduce the chance of staining. Use a damp cloth to dust and mop the tile surface using warm water. Additionally, try to avoid using harsh chemical cleaners or abrasive cleaning materials as these can damage the tile’s surface.

Advantages of Installing Porcelain Tiles over Polished Marble
Porcelain tiles are often preferred over polished marble for a number of reasons. For example, porcelain tiles do not require regular polishing or sealing, as marble does. Additionally, porcelain tiles don’t require frequent maintenance and won’t show scratches or chips as easily as marble.

Mimicking the appearance of natural wood, its grey hue adds a modern twist, making it a versatile choice for various interior styles. Whether it’s Scandinavian minimalism, industrial chic, or classic elegance, this flooring effortlessly complements diverse design schemes.
 One of its primary advantages lies in its resilience. LVT is renowned for its ability to withstand heavy foot traffic, spills, and scratches, making it ideal for high-traffic areas like kitchens, hallways, and living rooms. Its water-resistant properties also make it suitable for bathrooms and basements, providing peace of mind against moisture damage.

Maintenance is a breeze with grey wood effect LVT. Regular sweeping or vacuuming keeps it free from dust and debris, while occasional mopping with a mild detergent ensures its lustrous appearance endures. Beyond its practicality, this flooring adds warmth and character to any space. Its textured surface replicates the natural grain and knots found in wood, enhancing the authenticity of its appearance. In summary, grey wood effect LVT flooring combines style, durability, and ease of maintenance, making it a popular choice for modern homes and commercial spaces alike.

How to use:Preparation:Before fixing, all surfaces must be clean, dry and strong enough to support the weight of the tiles and adhesive. The floor or wall to be tiled must be free from excessive or sudden movement and be securely fixed to the supports. If you are using underfloor heating then this must be embedded in a layer of adhesive and allowed to set prior to fixing tiles.
Fixing:This high strength adhesive is extremely easy to use. It is one part, which means no admix is required. You simply mix the adhesive with cold tap water to a smooth and creamy mixture, either by hand or with a slow mechanical mixing paddle. Mix only a sufficient amount which can be used within 40 minutes, then apply the adhesive to the floor using a notched trowel. The layer of adhesive should be between 3mm and 6mm when the tiles are applied. Also apply adhesive to the back of deep studded tiles to cover the studs. Ensure the adhesive is still moist when the tiles are pressed into place. Surplus adhesive should be cleaned as soon as possible from the tiles and joints. Once all the tiles are fixed, grout can be applied after three hours.
Instructions are given as a guideline only, for your specific project needs please follow full instructions given on the bag

description:
#html-body data-pb-style=EIAK2XOjustify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scrollWide joint floor grout with an ivory limestone colour provides a secure fix on tiled floors with approx coverage 7.5m2 per bag. All you need to do is mix with water and apply to 3mm-20mm joints before letting the mixture set. The light colour is well suited to natural stone tiles of a similar shade like limestone or travertine. This combination creates a stylish stone floor perfect for bathrooms, kitchens, conservatories and even outdoor patios.
Premium quality one part flexible grout is easy to apply and suitable for grouting a variety of floor tiles including; Porcelain, Marble, Travertine, Limestone, Quartz, Ceramic, Granite and Slate. Our grout is waterproof making it perfect for shower areas and swimming pools. It is also compatible with underfloor heating. Wide Joint Floor Grout can be used in both internal and external areas.
Here’s how you use it:Ensure the tiles are firmly fixed and the joints are clean before grouting. Firstly, add the grout powder to cold clean tap water and mix into a smooth, slightly stiff consistency, which can be done by hand or with a mechanical mixing paddle. Mix only a sufficient amount which can be used within one hour. Work the grout into the joints to make sure they are completely filled.
Make sure you clean surplus grout from the tiles and joints as soon as possible as set grout will prove difficult to remove later. Allow 24 hours before walking on the surface. If you have installed an underfloor heating system it is recommended that you do not apply heat until two days after grouting your tiles.

description:
#html-body data-pb-style=F3BFLD0justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scrollYou simply mix this grey grout powder with water and apply between tile joints of 3mm-20mm for a sturdy and protective fixed floor application. Grey grout works impressively as part of the look of your tiled floor. For a darker contrast apply grey grout between light ivory or cream tiles. In contrast grey grout is equally well suited for a lighter shade between black tiles,approx coverage 7.5m2 per bag.
Premium quality one part flexible grout is easy to apply and suitable for grouting a variety of floor tiles including; Porcelain, Marble, Travertine, Limestone, Quartz, Ceramic, Granite and Slate. Our grout is waterproof making it perfect for shower areas and swimming pools. It is also compatible with underfloor heating. Wide Joint Floor Grout can be used in both internal and external areas.
Here’s how you use it:Ensure the tiles are firmly fixed and the joints are clean before grouting. Firstly, add the grout powder to cold clean tap water and mix into a smooth, slightly stiff consistency, which can be done by hand or with a mechanical mixing paddle. Mix only a sufficient amount which can be used within one hour. Work the grout into the joints to make sure they are completely filled.
Make sure you clean surplus grout from the tiles and joints as soon as possible as set grout will prove difficult to remove later. Allow 24 hours before walking on the surface. If you have installed an underfloor heating system it is recommended that you do not apply heat until two days after grouting your tiles.
Instructions are given as a guideline only, for your specific project needs please follow full instructions given on the bag

title: Epoxy Grout and Glitter
description:
#html-body data-pb-style=N9GA5SSjustify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scrollSimply add your epoxy grout and glitter to your shopping cart to get the grout and sparkle colour you desire

IMPORTANT The Glitter is only compatible with Sparkzle Epoxy Grout. If any other grout is used the desired glitter sparkle effect will not work. You need to use Sparkzle Epoxy Grout only with the Glitter.

Coverage approx 5m2 Epoxy Grout & 1 Bag of 150g glitter

Add a new dimension to your wall and floor designs with Sparkzle Glitter Grout. You simply mix the glitter with our two part epoxy grout to produce the Sparkzle glistening look which complements a range of different tiles. You can choose from glitter in either silver or gold colours - which are available in 150g bags. Create an amazing look in kitchens and bathrooms with Sparkzle glitter grout which has a genuine wow factor.

Our high quality epoxy mortar is available in 2.5kg tubs. To bring the sparkle simply add the 150g glitter pack that is available Gold and Silver
Waterproof Grout
Sparkzle not only looks great but it has the quality to match. This waterproof grout is perfect for bathrooms and wet rooms. You will also find Sparkzle easy to clean and maintain in kitchens as it is highly resilient against mould, stains and acid. This two part epoxy grout is suitable for high traffic areas in both residential and commercial properties. Epoxy Grout is available in 2.5kg and you can select from a range of colours.
Glitter Grout for a Variety of Tiles
Tiling contractors, homeowners and interior designers love Sparkzle glitter grout as it is an all-round excellent choice for a vast range of tiling projects. This grout is also fast setting which means jobs can be finished in super quick time. Sparkzle is often selected for use with glittery quartz as these tiles have sparkly mirror pieces which reflect light emphatically. Sparkzle, however, is not used exclusively with quartz as it is also chosen to complement marble, granite and other varieties to stunning effect.
Coverage approx 5m2 Epoxy Grout & 1 Bag of 150g glitter

title: Grout Protector
description:
#html-body data-pb-style=VK0IRK2justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scrollGrout Protector
Protect your tile grout from the damage caused by moisture, dirt, oil, grease and limescale with this quick drying, spray-on formula. Easy to use Grout and tile protector creates an impermeable barrier on otherwise porous grout lines. Colourless and odourless grout protector will also reduce the time you spend cleaning and maintaining bathroom and kitchen surfaces. This long lasting solution is suitable for grout lines between both natural stone and manmade tiles.
Natural stone tiles like travertine, marble, granite and limestone should be sealed with a suitable liquid impregnator and left to dry before applying this grout protector to grout lines for added resilience. With regards to manmade porcelain and ceramic the walls and floors simply require cleaning before spraying this protective solution onto grout. Grout and tile protector is also suitable for outdoor areas where it can be used for garden patios and pond surrounds
Newly grouted areas should be left for 20-30 minutes before this protective formula is applied. Mould and mildew should be removed from old grout first before spraying on a protective layer. Always test the protector on an inconspicuous area first to ensure it is compatible with the substrate. This product should be used in well ventilated areas
Directions: Shake can well before use and spray on to the surface from a distance of 15-20 cm. In standard bathroom and kitchen areas the formula should be allowed to cure for 2-3 hours before allowing foot traffic. In areas particularly prone to the build up of damp and mould like wet rooms and shower areas, surfaces should be left to cure for 24 hours. You can test the area with the application of a small amount of clean water. It is also recommended that you mask and protect surrounding wooden and acrylic surfaces before using this protective formula
